blurb: Calgary Shooting Centre offers firearms training courses including Canadian Firearms Safety Course and Range Safety Trauma Care. They provide memberships with various access and benefits, and allow walk-in shooting with gun rentals. The centre also offers specialized courses like Pistol Zero for new handgun owners.
extraNote: Cancellations require 72 hours notice to reschedule; no refunds for CFSC · Returns accepted within 14 days for new products in original packaging; ammunition and special orders final sale · Credit card payments accepted online via Visa and Mastercard
